name: jack_daniels_v_vip_counterclaims.txt
title: Jack Daniel's v. VIP Products (counterclaims, excerpt)
text:
COUNTERCLAIMS

1. Jack Daniel's Properties, Inc. ("JDPI") owns the trademarks JACK DANIEL'S and OLD NO. 7, and the distinctive trade dress of the Jack Daniel's Tennessee sour mash whiskey bottle and label, which have been used continuously in commerce for more than a century.

2. VIP Products LLC ("VIP") designs, markets and sells durable rubber squeaky chew toys for dogs under its Silly Squeakers line. One such dog toy, called "Bad Spaniels", is in the shape of a Jack Daniel's bottle and bears an imitation of the Jack Daniel's label, replacing "Old No. 7 Brand Tennessee Sour Mash Whiskey" with "The Old No. 2 on your Tennessee Carpet".

3. VIP sells the Bad Spaniels toy through pet supply stores and online retailers throughout the United States.

COUNT I: Trademark infringement, 15 U.S.C. § 1114, likelihood of confusion.
COUNT II: Dilution by tarnishment, 15 U.S.C. § 1125(c). The JACK DANIEL'S marks are famous and widely recognized by the general consuming public of the United States. Associating them with dog excrement tarnishes them.

name: cedar_hollow_cease_and_desist.txt
title: Cedar Hollow Candle Co. cease-and-desist (fictional)
text:
Re: Infringement of the CEDAR HOLLOW mark

Dear Ms. Alvarez,

We represent Cedar Hollow Candle Co., which has sold hand-poured soy candles and home fragrance under the CEDAR HOLLOW mark since 2009, through its own stores in Vermont and New Hampshire and online nationwide.

It has come to our attention that your company, Hollow Cedar Apparel LLC, recently began selling flannel shirts and outdoor apparel under the name HOLLOW CEDAR at outdoor retailers in Oregon and Washington. Consumers who know our client's candles are likely to believe your apparel is a licensed extension of the Cedar Hollow brand.

We demand that you cease all use of HOLLOW CEDAR within fourteen days.

name: taco_johns_petition_excerpt.txt
title: Taco Bell petition to cancel TACO TUESDAY (excerpt)
text:
PETITION FOR CANCELLATION

Petitioner Taco Bell IP Holder, LLC seeks cancellation of Registration No. 1,572,589 for the mark TACO TUESDAY, owned by Taco John's International, Inc., for restaurant services in all states except New Jersey.

The phrase "Taco Tuesday" is a common phrase used by restaurants, consumers and the public to refer to a weekly promotion of tacos on Tuesdays. Both parties operate quick-service Mexican-style restaurants marketed to the same class of consumers.
